description: This Java class 'ModelFieldTypeReader' reads and manages field type definitions from XML configuration files within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to load, cache, and retrieve field type metadata used in entity modeling.

classes.name: ModelFieldTypeReader
classes.description: A class that reads and caches field type definitions from XML files for entity modeling in OFBiz.

methods.name: createFieldTypeCache
methods.description: Parses an XML element to create a map of field type definitions.

methods.name: getModelFieldTypeReader
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of ModelFieldTypeReader for a given helper name, loading definitions if necessary.

methods.name: getModelFieldType
methods.description: Returns a ModelFieldType object for a given field type name from the cache.
